title: Keep playing while your next match fills
summary: Spectating, passive queues and safe match reconnection keep quiet periods useful without pulling players out of Skyblock too early.
body:
- Running MicroBattles, Pitchout, SkyWars, BuildBattles, TurfWars and BedWars matches can be opened in spectator mode from the game menu on Java and Bedrock. Spectators never occupy a participant slot or receive match statistics or rewards.
- While playing Skyblock or watching another match, players can join a minigame queue without leaving their current activity. The move happens only after the waiting room is ready and every selected player can leave safely.
- Queue status and cancellation are available through Java and Bedrock menus. Expired, full or replaced rooms are handled without silently moving a player.
- Players who are alone are guided towards available solo activities, especially Skyblock, while keeping the full game selector one action away.
- A short-lived in-game invitation appears when an underfilled waiting room needs players and again after a match ends. Automatic mobile player calls have been removed; an app notification is sent only after a player or administrator explicitly calls for teammates.
- A player who disconnects from an active match can return to the same MicroBattles, Pitchout, SkyWars, BuildBattles, TurfWars or BedWars session while its safe reconnect reservation is still valid. Finished or expired matches return the player to the lobby instead.
- Spectator exits, arena cleanup, Skyblock transfers and co-op removals preserve authoritative inventories and permissions before any lobby hand-off.

Java: play.cookie-build.com
Bedrock: play.cookie-build.com, port 19132
